sections.title: Academic Medical Center AI (UT Southwestern)
sections.description: UT Southwestern Medical Center (Dallas) — one of the US's top 10 research hospitals and a leading National Cancer Institute-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center.

blocks.heading: Cancer precision medicine AI
paragraphs: ML for UT Southwestern's Simmons Comprehensive Cancer Center — genomic variant interpretation, tumor mutation burden calculation, and treatment response prediction for UT Southwestern's large oncology program. UT Southwestern's research faculty have pioneered immunotherapy and targeted therapy approaches that require sophisticated AI to operationalize at scale.

blocks.heading: Clinical trial analytics
paragraphs: ML for UT Southwestern's large clinical research portfolio — patient eligibility identification from EHR data, trial enrollment prediction, and protocol deviation monitoring for the clinical trials spanning UT Southwestern's 30+ research specialties.

blocks.heading: Medical imaging AI
paragraphs: Deep learning for UT Southwestern's Radiology and Advanced Imaging Research Center — one of the largest radiology departments in the Southwest with extensive digital pathology and radiology AI research programs.

sections.title: Large Health System Operations (Baylor Scott & White)
sections.description: Baylor Scott & White Health (Dallas HQ) — the largest Texas-based and largest US not-for-profit health system with 52+ hospitals across Texas.

blocks.heading: Epic-integrated population health
paragraphs: ML for Baylor Scott & White's large Epic-deployed patient population — 30-day readmission prediction, sepsis early warning, and care gap identification deployed within the Epic clinical workflow for BS&W's large Texas hospital network.

blocks.heading: Texas Medicaid STAR and STAR+PLUS
paragraphs: ML for Baylor's participation in Texas's Medicaid managed care programs — population health stratification, care management prioritization, and quality measure performance prediction for the STAR and STAR+PLUS programs serving Texas's large Medicaid population.

blocks.heading: Revenue cycle optimization
paragraphs: ML for coding accuracy, denial prediction, and revenue integrity for Baylor Scott & White's enormous Texas billing operations.

blocks.heading: DFW population health

blocks.heading: Texas Medical Practice Act
paragraphs: Clinical AI in Texas must align with the Texas Medical Practice Act's regulations on clinical decision support and physician practice scope.

paragraphs: Texas's Health and Human Services Commission creates specific population health analytics requirements for managed care organizations participating in Texas's large STAR and STAR+PLUS programs.

sections.title: Dallas's healthcare AI investment trajectory
sections.description: Dallas's healthcare market has invested heavily in AI following the Baylor Scott & White system's scale and UT Southwestern's research ambitions.

blocks.heading: UT Southwestern's Nobel Prize culture and AI
paragraphs: UT Southwestern's extraordinary research culture — six Nobel Prize laureates on faculty — creates an environment where AI research investment is welcomed and scrutinized for scientific rigor. UT Southwestern's precision medicine programs are among the most sophisticated in the Southern US, and the academic depth of the institution creates healthcare AI demand that exceeds what community health systems alone would generate.

blocks.heading: Texas's large and growing population
paragraphs: Texas has added millions of residents over the past decade — the population growth of the Dallas metro area (the US's fourth-largest), driven by corporate relocations, domestic migration from higher-cost states, and international immigration, creates sustained healthcare demand growth that requires both capacity expansion and operational efficiency AI investment.

blocks.heading: Baylor Scott & White's operational scale
paragraphs: Baylor Scott & White Health is large enough — 52+ hospitals, 1,100+ access points, $11B+ in revenue — that even small percentage improvements in operational efficiency create tens of millions of dollars in value. The ROI case for ML at Baylor Scott & White's scale is clear, and the system has invested accordingly.
